programme.title: Žogarija
programme.desc: Žogarija je projekt, ki uteleša eno naših najpomembnejših prepričanj – da šport lahko izboljša kakovost življenja mladih. Žogarija: harmonija generacij je serija oddaj, ki skozi pristne zgodbe in pogovore povezuje otroke, starše in stare starše. Vsaka oddaja prikazuje medgeneracijsko sodelovanje, igre, ustvarjalnost in vrednote družine v središču lokalnega dogajanja. Gre za toplo, življenjsko serijo, ki spodbuja povezanost in aktivno skupnost.

programme.desc: School of Golf (Sports). Class is in session with Martin Hall, an award-winning golf teacher who has taught several players on the PGA Tour, Champions Tour and LPGA Tour. Each week his unique teaching style is on display with tips and drills utilizing an in-studio golf simulator. Joined by co-host and former «Big Break» champion Blair O'Neal, Martin also answers plenty of viewer emails and incorporates other forms of social media to help drive the show's content

programme.title: ⋗ SportsCenter
programme.desc: SportsCenter (Sports). The latest news, highlights and inside information from every corner of the sports world is presented each day on «SportsCenter,» ESPN's first-ever program when the network debuted in September of 1979. The flagship series airs an evening edition and a brand new late-night show each weekday before the stage is cleared for a live «SportsCenter» morning block that emphasizes fast-paced, highlights-driven reports and what's new on social media platforms

programme.title: ⋗ College Basketball: Michigan State vs. Duke (United Center, Chicago, IL, USA)
programme.desc: NCAA. Michigan State vs. DukeThe No. 6 Michigan State Spartans face the No. 2 Duke Blue Devils for an NCAA Division I game. Michigan State rides a two-game win streak with guard Jeremy Fears Jr. and Duke rides a two-game win streak with center Patrick Ngongba II in Chicago. Guests: Michigan State vs. Duke

programme.title: ⋗ CFP Rankings Show
programme.desc: CFP Rankings Show (Sports). The reveal of the top 25 college football teams, as chosen by the College Football Playoff Selection Committee

programme.title: ⋗ College Basketball: Kansas vs. Kentucky (United Center, Chicago, IL, USA)
programme.desc: NCAA. Kansas vs. KentuckyThe No. 17 Kansas Jayhawks face the No. 23 Kentucky Wildcats for an NCAA Division I game. Kansas rides a two-game win streak alongside guard Tre White, and Kentucky rides a two-game win streak alongside forward Milan Momcilovic in Chicago, Illinois. Guests: Kansas vs. Kentucky

programme.title: ⋗ SportsCenter With Scott Van Pelt
programme.desc: SportsCenter With Scott Van Pelt (Sports). SVP's up at midnight and bringing his unique perspective on games people play to «SportsCenter» viewers. The hourlong, late-night show is driven by the host's self-deprecating wit and passion for sports, with featured elements, including Van Pelt's nightly «1 Big Thing» commentary and a weekly look back at the moments that drove bettors wild in «Bad Beats.» The show also delivers what «SportsCenter» fans are used to – news and highlights, guests and interviews – but in a different, fast-paced and insightful way

programme.title: Endurance : 6 Heures de Spa-Francorchamps
programme.desc: Après Imola, direction le circuit de Spa-Francorchamps pour la deuxième épreuve du Championnat du monde d'endurance FIA 2026. L'an dernier, la Ferrari AF Corse #51 s'était imposée en Belgique, avec le Britannique James Calado et les Italiens Antonio Giovinazzi et Alessandro Pier Guidi. A un peu plus d'un mois des 24 Heures du Mans, le rendez-vous de Spa-Francorchamps s'annonce crucial.

programme.title: Cyclisme : Milan-San Remo
programme.desc: Qui succèdera au palmarès de Milan-San Remo à Mathieu van der Poel, vainqueur, l'an dernier au sprint, devant Filippo Ganna et Tadej Pogacar ? Pour la 117e édition de la "Primavera", le parcours a été rehaussé à 298 km, mais il proposera un scénario classique, avec la Cipressa et le Poggio comme juges de paix du premier Monument de la saison. La course se conclura, comme le veut la coutume, sur la Via Roma à San Remo.

programme.title: Kyren Wilson - Judd Trump
programme.desc: Le numéro 8 mondial, l'Anglais Kyren Wilson, remet son titre en jeu à Shanghai. L'an dernier, il s'était imposé en finale face à son compatriote Ali Carter (11-9). Il succédait ainsi au palmarès du tournoi chinois au numéro un mondial, Judd Trump, vainqueur en 2024. La légende Ronnie O'Sullivan est le joueur le plus titré à Shanghai. Il a remporté les Masters à cinq reprises (en 2009, 2017, 2018, 2019 et 2023).

programme.title: Endurance : 6 Heures de Spa-Francorchamps

L'an dernier, la Ferrari AF Corse #51 s'était imposée en Belgique, avec le Britannique James Calado et les Italiens Antonio Giovinazzi et Alessandro Pier Guidi. A un peu plus d'un mois des 24 Heures du Mans, le rendez-vous de Spa-Francorchamps s'annonce crucial.

programme.title: Escalade : Coupe du monde
programme.desc: Clap de fin pour la saison de difficulté à Santiago, au Chili. Chez les hommes, le Japonais Neo Suzuki, l'Espagnol Alberto Ginés Lopez et l'Indonésien Putra Tri Ramadani devraient se disputer la victoire. Côté féminin, la Slovène Janja Garnbret et l'Américaine Annie Sanders, qui ont remporté à elles deux toutes les manches cette saison, devraient à nouveau en découdre pour l'or.

programme.title: Cyclisme | Retour sur la saison 2026 (F)
programme.desc: Retour sur l'exercice 2026 de cyclisme chez les dames, une année marquée par la domination de Demi Vollering.

programme.title: Cyclisme | Retour sur la saison 2026 (H)
programme.desc: La saison cycliste masculine 2026 touche à sa fin. L'année a été marquée par la domination sans partage de certains leaders, des duels intenses sur les routes de la Vuelta et du Tour, et de grands moments d'émotions sur les Classiques et les Mondiaux. Côté individualités, on retiendra la belle saison de Tadej Pogacar, Remco Evenepoel, Paul Seixas, Wout van Aert ou encore Paul Magnier.

programme.title: Cyclisme : Paris-Roubaix
programme.desc: 123e édition de Paris-Roubaix, surnommé "l'enfer du Nord", qui inclut 30 secteurs pavés pour une distance totale de 258,3 km. Le vainqueur succédera au palmarès au Néerlandais Mathieu Van der Poel, lauréat des trois dernières éditions. L'édition 2026 proposera un nouvel enchaînement des premières difficultés, ainsi qu'un secteur pavé en montée. Le Slovène Tadej Pogacar n'a pas caché que Paris-Roubaix était l'un de ses principaux objectifs de la saison.

programme.title: NFL Fantasy Live
programme.desc: NFL Fantasy Live (Sports). Millions of NFL fans live in a fantasy world where survival depends on successfully navigating the twists and turns of a grueling season. After all, relying on a second-string quarterback or an untested wide receiver to come up big is usually foolhardy. Avoiding such predicaments takes plenty of preparation, and that's where «NFL Fantasy Live» comes into play. Host Marcas Grant provides the advice and analysis fantasy fans need to make winning lineup decisions. And being armed with the latest player updates, stats and trends goes a long way toward turning fantasies into championships

programme.title: Kyren Wilson - Judd Trump
programme.desc: Le numéro 8 mondial, l'Anglais Kyren Wilson, remet son titre en jeu à Shanghai. L'an dernier, il s'était imposé en finale face à son compatriote Ali Carter (11-9). Il succédait ainsi au palmarès du tournoi chinois au numéro un mondial, Judd Trump, vainqueur en 2024. La légende Ronnie O'Sullivan est le joueur le plus titré à Shanghai. Il a remporté les Masters à cinq reprises (en 2009, 2017, 2018, 2019 et 2023).

Côté individualités, on retiendra la belle saison de Tadej Pogacar, Remco Evenepoel, Paul Seixas, Wout van Aert ou encore Paul Magnier.

programme.title: Ski alpin : Coupe du monde à Crans-Montana
programme.desc: Diffusion de l'étape de Coupe du monde de ski alpin disputée dans une commune suisse du canton du Valais, située dans le district de Sierre. Chaque étape est divisée en trois disciplines : le slalom, le géant et la descente. La première Coupe du monde de ski alpin s'est déroulée en 1967.

programme.title: Cyclisme : Milan-San Remo
programme.desc: Qui succèdera au palmarès de Milan-San Remo à Mathieu van der Poel, vainqueur, l'an dernier au sprint, devant Filippo Ganna et Tadej Pogacar ? Pour la 117e édition de la "Primavera", le parcours a été rehaussé à 298 km, mais il proposera un scénario classique, avec la Cipressa et le Poggio comme juges de paix du premier Monument de la saison. La course se conclura, comme le veut la coutume, sur la Via Roma à San Remo.

programme.title: Kyren Wilson - Judd Trump
programme.desc: Le numéro 8 mondial, l'Anglais Kyren Wilson, remet son titre en jeu à Shanghai. L'an dernier, il s'était imposé en finale face à son compatriote Ali Carter (11-9). Il succédait ainsi au palmarès du tournoi chinois au numéro un mondial, Judd Trump, vainqueur en 2024. La légende Ronnie O'Sullivan est le joueur le plus titré à Shanghai. Il a remporté les Masters à cinq reprises (en 2009, 2017, 2018, 2019 et 2023).

programme.title: Endurance : 6 Heures de Spa-Francorchamps
programme.desc: Après Imola, direction le circuit de Spa-Francorchamps pour la deuxième épreuve du Championnat du monde d'endurance FIA 2026. L'an dernier, la Ferrari AF Corse #51 s'était imposée en Belgique, avec le Britannique James Calado et les Italiens Antonio Giovinazzi et Alessandro Pier Guidi. A un peu plus d'un mois des 24 Heures du Mans, le rendez-vous de Spa-Francorchamps s'annonce crucial.

programme.title: NFL Fantasy Live
programme.desc: NFL Fantasy Live (Sports). Millions of NFL fans live in a fantasy world where survival depends on successfully navigating the twists and turns of a grueling season. After all, relying on a second-string quarterback or an untested wide receiver to come up big is usually foolhardy. Avoiding such predicaments takes plenty of preparation, and that's where «NFL Fantasy Live» comes into play. Host Marcas Grant provides the advice and analysis fantasy fans need to make winning lineup decisions. And being armed with the latest player updates, stats and trends goes a long way toward turning fantasies into championships

The latest news, highlights and inside information from every corner of the sports world is presented each day on «SportsCenter,» ESPN's first-ever program when the network debuted in September of 1979. The flagship series airs an evening edition and a brand new late-night show each weekday before the stage is cleared for a live «SportsCenter» morning block that emphasizes fast-paced, highlights-driven reports and what's new on social media platforms

programme.title: ⋗ SportsCenter With Scott Van Pelt
programme.desc: SportsCenter With Scott Van Pelt (Sports). SVP's up at midnight and bringing his unique perspective on games people play to «SportsCenter» viewers. The hourlong, late-night show is driven by the host's self-deprecating wit and passion for sports, with featured elements, including Van Pelt's nightly «1 Big Thing» commentary and a weekly look back at the moments that drove bettors wild in «Bad Beats.» The show also delivers what «SportsCenter» fans are used to – news and highlights, guests and interviews – but in a different, fast-paced and insightful way

programme.title: ⋗ SportsCenter
programme.desc: SportsCenter (Sports). The latest news, highlights and inside information from every corner of the sports world is presented each day on «SportsCenter,» ESPN's first-ever program when the network debuted in September of 1979. The flagship series airs an evening edition and a brand new late-night show each weekday before the stage is cleared for a live «SportsCenter» morning block that emphasizes fast-paced, highlights-driven reports and what's new on social media platforms

programme.title: ⋗ Inside the NBA
programme.desc: Inside the NBA (Sports). This Emmy Award-winning studio show, which airs following NBA telecasts on ESPN, is hosted by Ernie Johnson, with analysis from Hall of Famer Charles Barkley and NBA champions Kenny Smith and Shaquille O'Neal. It's a mix of highlights, interviews and hijinks, notably the verbal sparring sessions between the outspoken Barkley and his straight man, Smith. The show also welcomes various guest analysts throughout the season

programme.title: ⋗ SportsCenter
programme.desc: SportsCenter (Sports). The latest news, highlights and inside information from every corner of the sports world is presented each day on «SportsCenter,» ESPN's first-ever program when the network debuted in September of 1979. The flagship series airs an evening edition and a brand new late-night show each weekday before the stage is cleared for a live «SportsCenter» morning block that emphasizes fast-paced, highlights-driven reports and what's new on social media platforms

The latest news, highlights and inside information from every corner of the sports world is presented each day on «SportsCenter,» ESPN's first-ever program when the network debuted in September of 1979. The flagship series airs an evening edition and a brand new late-night show each weekday before the stage is cleared for a live «SportsCenter» morning block that emphasizes fast-paced, highlights-driven reports and what's new on social media platforms

programme.title: ⋗ SportsCenter With Scott Van Pelt
programme.desc: SportsCenter With Scott Van Pelt (Sports). SVP's up at midnight and bringing his unique perspective on games people play to «SportsCenter» viewers. The hourlong, late-night show is driven by the host's self-deprecating wit and passion for sports, with featured elements, including Van Pelt's nightly «1 Big Thing» commentary and a weekly look back at the moments that drove bettors wild in «Bad Beats.» The show also delivers what «SportsCenter» fans are used to – news and highlights, guests and interviews – but in a different, fast-paced and insightful way

programme.title: ⋗ SportsCenter
programme.desc: SportsCenter (Sports). The latest news, highlights and inside information from every corner of the sports world is presented each day on «SportsCenter,» ESPN's first-ever program when the network debuted in September of 1979. The flagship series airs an evening edition and a brand new late-night show each weekday before the stage is cleared for a live «SportsCenter» morning block that emphasizes fast-paced, highlights-driven reports and what's new on social media platforms

The latest news, highlights and inside information from every corner of the sports world is presented each day on «SportsCenter,» ESPN's first-ever program when the network debuted in September of 1979. The flagship series airs an evening edition and a brand new late-night show each weekday before the stage is cleared for a live «SportsCenter» morning block that emphasizes fast-paced, highlights-driven reports and what's new on social media platforms

programme.title: ⋗ Inside the NBA
programme.desc: Inside the NBA (Sports). This Emmy Award-winning studio show, which airs following NBA telecasts on ESPN, is hosted by Ernie Johnson, with analysis from Hall of Famer Charles Barkley and NBA champions Kenny Smith and Shaquille O'Neal. It's a mix of highlights, interviews and hijinks, notably the verbal sparring sessions between the outspoken Barkley and his straight man, Smith. The show also welcomes various guest analysts throughout the season

programme.title: ⋗ SportsCenter
programme.desc: SportsCenter (Sports). The latest news, highlights and inside information from every corner of the sports world is presented each day on «SportsCenter,» ESPN's first-ever program when the network debuted in September of 1979. The flagship series airs an evening edition and a brand new late-night show each weekday before the stage is cleared for a live «SportsCenter» morning block that emphasizes fast-paced, highlights-driven reports and what's new on social media platforms

programme.title: ⋗ SportsCenter
programme.desc: SportsCenter (Sports). The latest news, highlights and inside information from every corner of the sports world is presented each day on «SportsCenter,» ESPN's first-ever program when the network debuted in September of 1979. The flagship series airs an evening edition and a brand new late-night show each weekday before the stage is cleared for a live «SportsCenter» morning block that emphasizes fast-paced, highlights-driven reports and what's new on social media platforms

programme.desc: SportsCenter (Sports). The latest news, highlights and inside information from every corner of the sports world is presented each day on «SportsCenter,» ESPN's first-ever program when the network debuted in September of 1979. The flagship series airs an evening edition and a brand new late-night show each weekday before the stage is cleared for a live «SportsCenter» morning block that emphasizes fast-paced, highlights-driven reports and what's new on social media platforms

The latest news, highlights and inside information from every corner of the sports world is presented each day on «SportsCenter,» ESPN's first-ever program when the network debuted in September of 1979. The flagship series airs an evening edition and a brand new late-night show each weekday before the stage is cleared for a live «SportsCenter» morning block that emphasizes fast-paced, highlights-driven reports and what's new on social media platforms

programme.title: ⋗ Inside the NBA
programme.desc: Inside the NBA (Sports). This Emmy Award-winning studio show, which airs following NBA telecasts on ESPN, is hosted by Ernie Johnson, with analysis from Hall of Famer Charles Barkley and NBA champions Kenny Smith and Shaquille O'Neal. It's a mix of highlights, interviews and hijinks, notably the verbal sparring sessions between the outspoken Barkley and his straight man, Smith. The show also welcomes various guest analysts throughout the season

programme.title: ⋗ Get Up
programme.desc: Get Up (Sports). ESPN's morning show features host Mike Greenberg with a rotating and diverse group of analysts opining about and analyzing the latest news from the world of sports. The two-hour, personality-driven show originates from Manhattan's South Street Seaport, a locale that attracts high-profile guests. Greenberg, aka «Greeny,» is formerly one-half of ESPN Radio's longtime «Mike Mike» morning show

programme.title: Whoop UCI Mountain Bike World Series
programme.desc: Vive lo más emocionante de la temporada 2026 de la WHOOP UCI Mountain Bike World Series. Cuatro disciplinas (Cross Country Olímpico, Short Track, Descenso y Enduro) se reparten 14 fines de semana de competición a lo largo de cinco meses, con presencia en tres continentes y nueve países. Un formato exigente que vuelve a poner a prueba la capacidad de adaptación de equipos y corredores.

programme.title: EuroLeague
programme.desc: Vive las emociones de los partidos de la 27º edición de la EuroLiga de básquet, la máxima competición de clubes de Europa. El torneo reúne a la élite del baloncesto masculino europeo y cuenta con 20 equipos participantes, que disputan el título bajo un sistema de liga con partidos de ida y vuelta.

programme.title: Paris-Tours
programme.desc: Disfruta las emociones de la edición 120 de esta carrera de ciclismo profesional que inicia en los alrededores de París y finaliza en Tours. Contará con muchos de los mejores ciclistas del circuito.

programme.desc: Disfruta de los partidos de la máxima categoría del fútbol profesional en Grecia. programme.title: ⋗ SportsCenter
programme.desc: SportsCenter (Sports). The latest news, highlights and inside information from every corner of the sports world is presented each day on «SportsCenter,» ESPN's first-ever program when the network debuted in September of 1979. The flagship series airs an evening edition and a brand new late-night show each weekday before the stage is cleared for a live «SportsCenter» morning block that emphasizes fast-paced, highlights-driven reports and what's new on social media platforms

programme.title: ⋗ College Basketball: Michigan State vs. Duke (United Center, Chicago, IL, USA)
programme.desc: NCAA. Michigan State vs. DukeThe No. 6 Michigan State Spartans face the No. 2 Duke Blue Devils for an NCAA Division I game. Michigan State rides a two-game win streak with guard Jeremy Fears Jr. and Duke rides a two-game win streak with center Patrick Ngongba II in Chicago. Guests: Michigan State vs. Duke

programme.title: ⋗ CFP Rankings Show
programme.desc: CFP Rankings Show (Sports). The reveal of the top 25 college football teams, as chosen by the College Football Playoff Selection Committee

programme.title: ⋗ College Basketball: Kansas vs. Kentucky (United Center, Chicago, IL, USA)
programme.desc: NCAA. Kansas vs. KentuckyThe No. 17 Kansas Jayhawks face the No. 23 Kentucky Wildcats for an NCAA Division I game. Kansas rides a two-game win streak alongside guard Tre White, and Kentucky rides a two-game win streak alongside forward Milan Momcilovic in Chicago, Illinois. Guests: Kansas vs. Kentucky

programme.title: ⋗ SportsCenter With Scott Van Pelt
programme.desc: SportsCenter With Scott Van Pelt (Sports). SVP's up at midnight and bringing his unique perspective on games people play to «SportsCenter» viewers. The hourlong, late-night show is driven by the host's self-deprecating wit and passion for sports, with featured elements, including Van Pelt's nightly «1 Big Thing» commentary and a weekly look back at the moments that drove bettors wild in «Bad Beats.» The show also delivers what «SportsCenter» fans are used to – news and highlights, guests and interviews – but in a different, fast-paced and insightful way

programme.title: ⋗ SportsCenter
programme.desc: SportsCenter (Sports). The latest news, highlights and inside information from every corner of the sports world is presented each day on «SportsCenter,» ESPN's first-ever program when the network debuted in September of 1979. The flagship series airs an evening edition and a brand new late-night show each weekday before the stage is cleared for a live «SportsCenter» morning block that emphasizes fast-paced, highlights-driven reports and what's new on social media platforms

programme.title: ⋗ SportsCenter With Scott Van Pelt
programme.desc: SportsCenter With Scott Van Pelt (Sports). SVP's up at midnight and bringing his unique perspective on games people play to «SportsCenter» viewers. The hourlong, late-night show is driven by the host's self-deprecating wit and passion for sports, with featured elements, including Van Pelt's nightly «1 Big Thing» commentary and a weekly look back at the moments that drove bettors wild in «Bad Beats.» The show also delivers what «SportsCenter» fans are used to – news and highlights, guests and interviews – but in a different, fast-paced and insightful way

The hourlong, late-night show is driven by the host's self-deprecating wit and passion for sports, with featured elements, including Van Pelt's nightly «1 Big Thing» commentary and a weekly look back at the moments that drove bettors wild in «Bad Beats.» The show also delivers what «SportsCenter» fans are used to – news and highlights, guests and interviews – but in a different, fast-paced and insightful way

programme.desc: SportsCenter (Sports). The latest news, highlights and inside information from every corner of the sports world is presented each day on «SportsCenter,» ESPN's first-ever program when the network debuted in September of 1979. The flagship series airs an evening edition and a brand new late-night show each weekday before the stage is cleared for a live «SportsCenter» morning block that emphasizes fast-paced, highlights-driven reports and what's new on social media platforms

programme.title: ⋗ Inside the NBA
programme.desc: Inside the NBA (Sports). This Emmy Award-winning studio show, which airs following NBA telecasts on ESPN, is hosted by Ernie Johnson, with analysis from Hall of Famer Charles Barkley and NBA champions Kenny Smith and Shaquille O'Neal. It's a mix of highlights, interviews and hijinks, notably the verbal sparring sessions between the outspoken Barkley and his straight man, Smith. The show also welcomes various guest analysts throughout the season

programme.title: ⋗ SportsCenter With Scott Van Pelt
programme.desc: SportsCenter With Scott Van Pelt (Sports). SVP's up at midnight and bringing his unique perspective on games people play to «SportsCenter» viewers. The hourlong, late-night show is driven by the host's self-deprecating wit and passion for sports, with featured elements, including Van Pelt's nightly «1 Big Thing» commentary and a weekly look back at the moments that drove bettors wild in «Bad Beats.» The show also delivers what «SportsCenter» fans are used to – news and highlights, guests and interviews – but in a different, fast-paced and insightful way

programme.desc: SportsCenter (Sports). The latest news, highlights and inside information from every corner of the sports world is presented each day on «SportsCenter,» ESPN's first-ever program when the network debuted in September of 1979. The flagship series airs an evening edition and a brand new late-night show each weekday before the stage is cleared for a live «SportsCenter» morning block that emphasizes fast-paced, highlights-driven reports and what's new on social media platforms

The latest news, highlights and inside information from every corner of the sports world is presented each day on «SportsCenter,» ESPN's first-ever program when the network debuted in September of 1979. The flagship series airs an evening edition and a brand new late-night show each weekday before the stage is cleared for a live «SportsCenter» morning block that emphasizes fast-paced, highlights-driven reports and what's new on social media platforms

programme.title: ⋗ Get Up
programme.desc: Get Up (Sports). ESPN's morning show features host Mike Greenberg with a rotating and diverse group of analysts opining about and analyzing the latest news from the world of sports. The two-hour, personality-driven show originates from Manhattan's South Street Seaport, a locale that attracts high-profile guests. Greenberg, aka «Greeny,» is formerly one-half of ESPN Radio's longtime «Mike Mike» morning show

programme.title: ⋗ Inside the NBA
programme.desc: Inside the NBA (Sports). This Emmy Award-winning studio show, which airs following NBA telecasts on ESPN, is hosted by Ernie Johnson, with analysis from Hall of Famer Charles Barkley and NBA champions Kenny Smith and Shaquille O'Neal. It's a mix of highlights, interviews and hijinks, notably the verbal sparring sessions between the outspoken Barkley and his straight man, Smith. The show also welcomes various guest analysts throughout the season

programme.title: ⋗ SportsCenter
programme.desc: SportsCenter (Sports). The latest news, highlights and inside information from every corner of the sports world is presented each day on «SportsCenter,» ESPN's first-ever program when the network debuted in September of 1979. The flagship series airs an evening edition and a brand new late-night show each weekday before the stage is cleared for a live «SportsCenter» morning block that emphasizes fast-paced, highlights-driven reports and what's new on social media platforms

programme.title: SportsCenter
programme.desc: SportsCenter (Sports). The latest news, highlights and inside information from every corner of the sports world is presented each day on «SportsCenter,» ESPN's first-ever program when the network debuted in September of 1979. The flagship series airs an evening edition and a brand new late-night show each weekday before the stage is cleared for a live «SportsCenter» morning block that emphasizes fast-paced, highlights-driven reports and what's new on social media platforms

The latest news, highlights and inside information from every corner of the sports world is presented each day on «SportsCenter,» ESPN's first-ever program when the network debuted in September of 1979. The flagship series airs an evening edition and a brand new late-night show each weekday before the stage is cleared for a live «SportsCenter» morning block that emphasizes fast-paced, highlights-driven reports and what's new on social media platforms

programme.title: ⋗ College Basketball: Michigan State vs. Duke (United Center, Chicago, IL, USA)
programme.desc: NCAA. Michigan State vs. DukeThe No. 6 Michigan State Spartans face the No. 2 Duke Blue Devils for an NCAA Division I game. programme.title: ⋗ SportsCenter With Scott Van Pelt
programme.desc: SportsCenter With Scott Van Pelt (Sports). SVP's up at midnight and bringing his unique perspective on games people play to «SportsCenter» viewers. The hourlong, late-night show is driven by the host's self-deprecating wit and passion for sports, with featured elements, including Van Pelt's nightly «1 Big Thing» commentary and a weekly look back at the moments that drove bettors wild in «Bad Beats.» The show also delivers what «SportsCenter» fans are used to – news and highlights, guests and interviews – but in a different, fast-paced and insightful way
